correctness.rationale: The RKL2 three-stage polynomial is expanded exactly. Explicit products for path lengths \(N=2,3,4,5\) verify the stated coefficients; the tridiagonal band structure yields the same formulas for all \(N\). The two critical boundary-adjacent factors have exact roots \((15-\sqrt{30})/13\) and \((15-\sqrt{15})/14\). All other entries are proved nonnegative up to the relevant lower root, and the critical entry is negative above it within \(0\leq c\leq5/4\).

residual_risks: The full text of Dawes (2021) was not accessible, so it may contain a more specific analysis of the same stage-three boundary threshold. value.rationale: The nonnegative cone is a physically meaningful invariant for heat flow. A sharp positivity cutoff distinguishes spectral stability from order preservation at Dirichlet boundaries and gives an exact finite-grid rule rather than a numerical observation. The \(N=2\) versus \(N\geq3\) transition identifies a real boundary-size effect and supplies a reusable benchmark for testing stage-selection rules.
